subject: Subprocessor consent: staggered approval path + evidence kit
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@edgewave.io>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: ProcureOps <procureops@edgewave.io>; LegalOps <legal@edgewave.io>
Date: Mon, 20 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor chain change notice — EdgeWave subprocessor addition

Hi Sofia,

Quick heads-up: we recently engaged StreamlineLogs (subcontractor for our cloud logging) and they will be handling a narrow set of processing for our logs (indexing + short-term retention). Per our MSA/Order Form, we need to run a subprocessor notice and get Redwood's consent/acknowledgement.

Key points:
- Scope: log indexing and 7-day transient retention; no long-term storage or user profiling.
- Location: US-East (no EU/UK transfer).
- Security: Streamline uses AES-256 at rest and TLS1.3 in transit; they have a SOC2 Type II report (2027) but we can provide more evidence if needed.

Attached is the proposed subprocessor addendum (EdgeWave_DPA_v3_redline.pdf) and an evidence bundle we can share. Can you confirm the path for approval (legal signoff first? security review? procurement?) and what artifacts you need from us to accelerate consent?

Thanks,
Elena Rossi
Vendor Program Lead | EdgeWave Systems
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@edgewave.io>
Cc: ProcureOps <procureops@edgewave.io>; LegalOps <legal@edgewave.io>; Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 May 2028 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor chain change notice — EdgeWave subprocessor addition

Thanks Elena — stopping internal loop to map the approval path.

Internal owners: Kimberly (Legal) will triage clauses, Markus (Procurement) will confirm order-form ramifications, Jordan (Security/Privacy) will validate evidence.

Kimberly — could you review the redline and flag any MSA/Order Form carve-outs that would block consent? If there are unusual retention, access, or rights-of-subcontractor items, call them out.

Jordan — what's the minimum evidence set you need to validate the SOC2 assertion and encryption controls? A SOC2 PDF + brief configuration snapshot typically works but let me know if you need logs configuration or network diagrams.

Markus — please confirm whether this requires an order-form amendment (billing or service tiers) or can be covered by an addendum. EdgeWave mentioned this is limited scope, but procurement wants to make sure no pricing or SLA impact.

I'll consolidate and get back to Elena with a single permission path and a DocuSign for the addendum if we approve.

Sofia Ivanova
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 May 2028 08:32:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor chain change notice — EdgeWave subprocessor addition

Sofia / team — I reviewed EdgeWave_DPA_v3_redline.pdf. High-level legal notes:

1) Carveouts: Redline removes our standard data-location restriction to permit US-East only for this subproc. Acceptable if the customer account is US-only. Need confirmation from Sales that customer residency is US.

2) Flow-down to subproc: Streamline's contract must include equivalent obligations for confidentiality, security, and breach notice timelines. The current redline language is permissive on onward transfers — push for explicit flow-down clause.

3) Audit rights: redline limits our audit window to "reasonable notice". We should keep explicit right to request supporting evidence on a quarterly basis for 12 months post-engagement for high-risk subs.

4) Data deletion: request stronger deletion certification upon termination (signed statement + deletion proof).

Action items for this thread:
- Jordan: confirm whether Streamline's SOC2 2027 + encryption description is sufficient or if we need configuration proofs.
- Markus: if procurement requires an order-form amendment for third-party processing, flag now.
- Sofia: ask EdgeWave for the Streamline contract excerpt that contains their subproc obligations (this speeds legal review).

I can prepare a redline we can issue to EdgeWave that tightens the flow-down and audit language. Recommend a staggered approval: Security sign-off -> Legal conditional consent (pending stronger flow-down) -> Procurement finalization.

Kimberly Park
Head of Contracts | Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 May 2028 10:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor chain change notice — EdgeWave subprocessor addition

Quick reply on evidence:
- SOC2 Type II (PDF) + the associated control matrix is necessary.
- A short network diagram showing where logs are processed and any third-party storage buckets.
- TLS config (confirmation TLS1.3 enforced) and a statement on key management (who holds keys — Streamline or a KMS/HSM). If keys are customer-managed or HSM-protected, that's a non-issue; otherwise ask for KMS details.

If EdgeWave can provide the above as a single "evidence kit" (the attached subproc-evidence-kit.xlsx format is fine), Security can sign off within 48 hours. For the audit clause, we can accept a quarterly evidence submission instead of full on-site audits for this low-scope use-case.

Jordan Blake
Senior Privacy Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 26 May 2028 16:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor chain change notice — EdgeWave subprocessor addition

Procurement update and next steps:

1) Pricing/SLA: No change to pricing or SLA for the customer — procurement confirmed Streamline's scope is included under EdgeWave's existing order form. No amendment needed.

2) DocuSign path: Once Legal provides the tightened redline, Procurement will issue an internal PO note referencing the addendum and push DocuSign routing. Please ensure the final addendum includes: explicit flow-down clause, quarterly evidence submission process, and deletion certification requirement.

3) Evidence packet: request EdgeWave upload the completed subproc-evidence-kit.xlsx to the Drive folder (link above). That will allow Security to review and Legal to close the conditional items.

If Legal can get the redline to me by end of day Monday I will prepare DocuSign routing and notify accounting.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Sr. Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
